lines: Of this, of all, of world, at ends everywhere:
Śiva-reality meditated by path-procedure — great rise.
l4.sanskrit_cite: asya sarvasya viśvasya paryanteṣu samantataḥ | adhvaprakriyayā tattvaṃ śaivaṃ dhyatvā mahodayaḥ
